zh.title: 投资房出售：折旧回收、资本利得和加州预扣
zh.seo_title: 加州投资房出售税务概念｜陈靖
zh.description: 出售湾区出租房或投资房前要了解的税务概念：折旧回收、联邦资本利得、NIIT、加州按普通收入计税，以及 Form 593 和 3⅓% 预扣，附与 CPA 确认的清单。
zh.lead: 投资房的账比自住房复杂，折旧、联邦税、加州税和过户时的预扣都要算。这篇讲一般概念，帮你在挂牌前知道该问 CPA 什么。

en.title: Selling an Investment Property: Depreciation, Gains and CA Withholding
en.seo_title: Selling an Investment Property in CA | Jing Chen
en.description: Depreciation recapture, federal capital gains, the NIIT, California treatment and Form 593 withholding: what to raise with your CPA before listing.
en.lead: An investment sale involves more moving parts than selling your home: depreciation, federal and state tax, and withholding at closing. These are the concepts to discuss with your CPA.

sources.label: IRS：Publication 544 Sales and Other Dispositions of Assets
